description.en: The ID of the EIP bandwidth plan.

description.zh:
共享带宽的描述信息。  
长度为0-256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en: The description of the EIP bandwidth plan. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
共享带宽的名称。 
长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en: The name of the EIP bandwidth plan. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
共享带宽所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the EIP bandwidth plan is created.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 修改共享带宽实例的名称和描述信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc modify-common-bandwidth-package-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-2ze2ic1xd2qeqk1450000 --name test123 --description '描述' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc ModifyCommonBandwidthPackageAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description '描述' --BandwidthPackageId 'cbwp-2ze2ic1xd2qeqk1450000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name test123
